description: Full half of the ISS-022 split: re-resolve config per tool call and rebuild the backend when the effective config changes. MUST satisfy the requirements from the 2026-07-02 deliberate-deep plan review (both providers: revise): (1) composite rebuild lifecycle — in-flight reviews must complete on the old composite; define disposal/draining so nothing leaks; (2) don't rely solely on mtime (1s granularity, same-mtime edits) — pair with size/content hash; (3) failure policy for ALL modes: missing file, unreadable, invalid JSON, Zod validation failure — keep last-good config and warn once per bad state; (4) runtime-reloadable codex_path is a security surface — decide whether to honor path changes without restart or exclude exec-path fields from hot reload; (5) define effective-config equality (which fields participate, path normalization); (6) synchronization for concurrent tool calls (single reload in flight); (7) test strategy for the timing-sensitive paths. CLI unchanged (already per-invocation). Resolves ISS-022 together with T-034.
title: Per-call config reload in the MCP server, per the reviewed requirements (ISS-022b)
